mechanism: Senna's laxative effect can reduce tolterodine absorption and efficacy while tolterodine's anticholinergic properties may reduce senna's gastrointestinal motility, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects.
action: Monitor therapeutic response to tolterodine; separate administration times by at least 2 hours and counsel patients on adequate hydration to minimize laxative-induced fluid/electrolyte losses that may affect tolterodine metabolism.
